captions.detailed: This is a compact personal blender resembling a NutriBullet style. It features a cylindrical black base with a grey top ring, upon which sits a transparent cylindrical cup. Inside the bottom of the cup, a four-blade stainless steel cross assembly is visible, designed to rotate continuously. The top of the cup is sealed with a black plastic lid that has a small flip-top tab on a hinge for drinking.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a compact personal blender. It should include a black cylindrical power base with a grey accent ring, a transparent plastic blending cup, a rotating four-blade cross assembly inside the base of the cup, and a black lid with a flip-top tab on a hinge.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a black cylinder and a grey ring cylinder. Create the cup as a hollow transparent cylinder. Create the cross blades using two intersecting boxes rotated relative to each other, and mount them on a continuous rotation joint inside the cup base. Design the lid as a black cylinder with a small rectangular flip-top tab connected via a revolute hinge at the rim.
